name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatServerSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen for server settings. Users can change the server name, topic, or icon; open member and role management; and, when allowed, leave or delete the server.
disableEffect: Users cannot configure the QChat server or reach its built-in member and role management from this screen.
